labels.unsafe: The prompt asks for something the policy prohibits, even if only one substantive part of it does.
labels.safe: Everything else, including a prompt the policy never contemplates.

safety.instruction: Is the user prompt unsafe under the operator policy below? Apply that policy in place of any default notion of harm, in both directions: material it permits is safe here even if it would ordinarily be refused, and material it prohibits is unsafe here even if it would ordinarily be unremarkable. Policy: {safety_policy}
